description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class for an Android application that demonstrates creating, signing, and verifying digital signatures using the Android Key Store. It includes methods for generating key pairs, signing data, and verifying signatures, with UI event handlers to trigger these processes.

classes.name: BasicAndroidKeyStoreFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment class that manages cryptographic key creation, data signing, and verification using Android Key Store APIs, with UI controls for triggering these actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets the menu options, and assigns a default alias for the key pair.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Lifecycle method triggered after activity creation; included but doesn't contain additional logic.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to create keys, sign data, or verify signatures, and manages associated cryptographic operations.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates an RSA key pair, with different implementations for pre- and post-Android M, storing it in the Android Key Store.

methods.name: signData
methods.description: Signs input data with the private key from the Android Key Store, returning a base64-encoded signature string.

methods.name: verifyData
methods.description: Verifies the provided signature against input data using the public key from the Android Key Store.

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias used to identify the key pair in the Key Store.
